title: What each layer builds

objective.text: Relate each germ layer to the main tissues it builds.

body.general: Which layer made your brain, your bones and your gut lining? Where a cell goes in through the streak decides what it becomes [f1]. Ectoderm builds the parts that face or sense the outside: the brain, nerves, skin surface and sense organs [f2]. Mesoderm builds bones, muscles, the heart, vessels, blood, kidneys and gonads [f3]. Endoderm lines the gut and airways and forms the working cells of the liver and pancreas [f4].
body.mbbs: Langman's fate map shows that the place a cell passes through the node or streak decides its fate [f1]. Ectoderm forms the central and peripheral nervous systems, the sensory epithelia of ear, nose and eye, and the epidermis with hair and nails [f2]. It also forms the pituitary, the mammary and sweat glands and tooth enamel [f6]. Mesoderm forms vertebrae and ribs, skeletal muscle, dermis, the urogenital system, heart, vessels and blood cells [f3]. Endoderm lines the gut, respiratory tract and bladder, and forms the working cells of the thyroid, liver and pancreas [f4].

facts.text: Where a cell passes through the node or streak decides what it becomes.

facts.text: Ectoderm builds the nervous system, the sensory linings of ear, nose and eye, and the epidermis with hair and nails.
Ectoderm also builds the pituitary, skin glands such as mammary and sweat glands, and tooth enamel.
Mesoderm builds vertebrae and ribs, skeletal muscle, dermis, kidneys and gonads, the heart, vessels and blood cells.
Endoderm lines the gut, airways, bladder and urethra, and forms the working cells of the thyroid, liver and pancreas.
Beyond Langman: human stage-7 data show early mesoderm subtypes already forming, though not where each one entered.

misconceptions.right: It also makes the whole nervous system, the sense-organ linings, the pituitary and tooth enamel.

misconceptions.wrong: The bladder is mesoderm, like the rest of the urogenital system.
misconceptions.right: Its lining is endoderm; kidneys, gonads and ducts are mesoderm.

checks.prompt: Which germ layer builds the brain and spinal cord?
checks.why: The nervous system is ectoderm, the layer that faces and senses the outside.

checks.prompt: The lining of the urinary bladder comes from which layer?
checks.why: Kidneys and gonads are mesoderm, but the bladder lining is endoderm.
Heart, vessels, blood, bone and muscle are mesoderm; the others are endoderm or ectoderm.

adult: Every adult organ can be traced to one, two or all three of these layers [f2,f3,f4].

remember.q: What decides what a gastrulating cell becomes?
remember.a: Where it passes through the node or streak [f1].

remember.q: Which layer lines the gut and airways?
What are three things mesoderm builds?
remember.a: For example bone, skeletal muscle and the heart [f3].
